decisions.reason: The award is an early positive signal, and as a close extension of the existing dairy range it is inexpensive to keep while demand uncertainty is still resolving.
Because it was highlighted on the home page and presented as a flagship product, management would likely continue backing it rather than abandon it after only a short market test.
It fits the established cheese business, but with no special positive signal and several other new cheese options in the portfolio it has a somewhat higher risk of later pruning.
A multi-model spicy cheese line creates a broader option on customer preferences, so the firm is likely to keep it while learning which variants work best.
This soft-cheese extension still sits close to the core offer and is worth retaining for now, though its lower strategic prominence makes it less protected than the flagship launches.
The washed-rind soft cheese is more niche and likely somewhat costlier to carry, but with no clear evidence of failure yet the option value still supports keeping it for another year.
